changes.before: An AI chatbot can give outdated answers because it is using old source material, a knowledge connection has not picked up a change, retrieval selects the wrong version, or earlier conversation content influences the reply. Sometimes the information is current but the model interprets it incorrectly. The symptom alone does not identify the cause.
changes.after: An AI chatbot can give outdated answers because it is still using old business information. A connection may not have picked up a change, search may select the wrong document, or an earlier conversation may influence the reply. Sometimes the information supplied is current and the model interprets it incorrectly. The symptom alone does not tell you which part failed.
changes.reason: Responder en lenguaje de dueño de negocio antes de introducir retrieval, sin cambiar las causas.

changes.before: For a service business, this matters when customers ask about inclusions, service areas, opening hours or the next available appointment. A useful chatbot needs a maintained route to the right information and a clear response when that information cannot be established.
changes.after:
Suppose you run an Australian service business and change your standard plan to weekday visits, with Saturdays requiring separate confirmation. Your website says so, but the chatbot still tells customers Saturday visits are included. We will follow this fictional example below.

The same problem can affect service areas, opening hours and appointment questions. Your chatbot needs a maintained route to the right information and a clear response when it cannot establish the answer.

changes.before: The repair needs to address source eligibility and the route that selects evidence. Merely editing the website again would miss the established cause. The team should also verify that K2-v2 is accessible and retrieved with its conditions intact.
changes.after: Editing the website again would leave that old PDF in the search route. Ask your provider to check why K1-v1 was eligible and selected, then verify that K2-v2 can be found with its conditions intact.
changes.reason: Concretar la acción y acortar abstracciones sin confundir presencia con recuperación.

changes.before: An appropriate answer would explain that the standard plan covers weekday visits and that Saturday arrangements need separate confirmation. It would not invent a Saturday price or promise a slot. Other cases can have different causes, so this example is not a diagnosis of every outdated answer.
changes.after: The answer should say that the standard plan covers weekday visits and Saturdays need separate confirmation. It should not invent a price or promise a slot. Other outdated answers need their own evidence.
